defectFixed.symptom: System back / back gesture on any task page returned to the launcher instead of the app home page
defectFixed.cause: AppShell switches task pages by state (section + overlay flags) rather than routes, and nothing handled system back, so the root route popped and Android left the app. iOS has no system back, so this was not visible upstream
defectFixed.fix: AppShell wraps its Scaffold in PopScope: only the home page with no overlay hands back to the platform; elsewhere system back performs the same step as the page's top-left back arrow (overlay first, then the parent section; outdoor navigation still asks before ending an active route via _select)
